readme.text:
Every warning
Cost-effectiveness and incremental cost analysis: figures and tables

Study: Every warning
Prepared by: n/a
Date: October 18, 2026
Status: Draft
Made by CEICA 1.0.0 (engine 1); project digest a95b09a27fb9

In this folder
  Figures and tables.docx, .pdf and .html: every figure and table with its number and caption, and the methods.
  Figures: each figure as PNG (300 dpi, for documents and slides) and SVG (to edit).
  Tables: each table as CSV, and All tables.xlsx with a sheet per table.
  Every warning calculator.xlsx: every input and result as live formulas.
  Every warning.ceica: the project file. Open it in CEICA to continue the study.

Figures
  Figure 1. Cost-effectiveness (A) and incremental cost (B) of the alternatives at site Up.
    Figures/Figure 01 Site Up.png and .svg
  Figure 2. Habitat units over time (A) and average annual cost by part (B) of the alternatives at site Up.
    Figures/Figure 02 Benefits and costs, site Up.png and .svg

Tables
  Table 1. Study settings and the record of this analysis.
    Tables/Table 01 Study settings.csv
  Table 2. Best-buy plans and their incremental costs. Site columns: 1 when the plan includes the site, 0 when not.
    Tables/Table 02 Best-buy plans.csv
  Table 3. Final array of plans. Site columns: 1 when the plan includes the site, 0 when not.
    Tables/Table 03 Final array.csv
  Table 4. The plans: lift, cost and status (2 plans). Site columns: 1 when the plan includes the site, 0 when not.
    Tables/Table 04 All plans.csv
  Table 5. Cost-effectiveness and incremental cost of every alternative at every site. Incremental cost applies to best buys.
    Tables/Table 05 Alternatives at every site.csv
  Table 6. The alternative each site carries forward, and the status of that decision.
    Tables/Table 06 Site recommendations.csv
  Table 7. Decisions and the reasons recorded for them.
    Tables/Table 07 Decision record.csv
  Table 8. Average annual output, lift, construction cost and annualized cost of every alternative. The CE/ICA tables measure cost above No Action.
    Tables/Table 08 Benefit and cost inputs.csv
  Table 9. First costs by category, interest during construction, OMRRR and annualized cost of every alternative.
    Tables/Table 09 Cost by category.csv

Reading the data files
  CSV files hold plain numbers: lift and cost are the rounded values the analysis compared, so sorting reproduces its ties. TRUE and FALSE mark cost-effective plans and best buys. A blank cell has no value; in a plan table, a blank site column means the site is not in the plan.
  In All tables.xlsx, numbers keep their full precision under the display format, and a missing value reads n/a.
